1.name: Kamoni Williams
1.about: Entering Kansas as the projected No. 1 overall pick, Williams possesses generational potential with his extraordinary size, mobility and two-way versatility. The 7'3" freshman combines elite rim protection, impressive offensive coordination and exceptional length, establishing himself as a potential franchise-altering NBA prospect.

2.name: Olavi Metsälä
2.about: The Finnish sensation arrives at UConn as one of the most versatile big men in the country. Standing 6'10", Metsälä combines impressive perimeter shooting, fluid mobility and explosive finishing ability, giving the Huskies a dynamic offensive weapon with tremendous NBA upside.

3.name: Miro Sanderson
3.about: One of Australia's premier young prospects, Sanderson enters the season as a highly regarded international floor general. The 6'6" guard combines exceptional court vision, disciplined perimeter defense and reliable outside shooting, showcasing the versatility and basketball intelligence to become an impactful NBA playmaker.

4.name: Marteese Jefferson
4.about: A five-star recruit and one of the nation's most celebrated incoming freshmen, Jefferson arrives at Duke with enormous expectations. The 6'5" shooting guard possesses elite shot-making instincts, deep shooting range and polished offensive footwork, establishing himself as a potential NBA star.

5.name: Youssouf Toledano
5.about: An explosive French wing with elite physical tools, Toledano enters the season as one of Europe's most exciting young prospects. His powerful frame, lightning-quick first step and exceptional leaping ability make him a devastating downhill attacker with tremendous potential on both ends.

6.name: Bradley Washington
6.about: A five-star prospect ranked among the nation's top 10 recruits, Washington arrives at Miami with tremendous expectations. The 6'10" freshman combines a powerful interior presence with polished midrange scoring, soft shooting touch and impressive footwork, establishing himself as a potential lottery selection.

7.name: Sky Lewis Jr.
7.about: Lewis enters his junior season at Murray State as one of the nation's premier returning guards and a projected lottery pick. The 6'4" playmaker combines advanced pull-up scoring, crafty ball handling and impressive offensive instincts, positioning himself for a potential All-American campaign.

8.name: Kione Anthony
8.about: A five-star recruit with tremendous two-way potential, Anthony arrives at UConn as one of the nation's most exciting freshman wings. The 6'6" guard combines explosive athleticism, aggressive perimeter defense and promising outside shooting, positioning himself as an immediate contributor with significant NBA upside.

9.name: Hashujani Maliffeno
9.about: After transferring from Miami to St. John's, Maliffeno enters his sophomore season as one of the nation's most intriguing big men. The powerful 6'8" center combines explosive interior finishing, impressive rebounding instincts and reliable perimeter shooting, positioning himself for a breakout campaign.

10.name: Justus Williams
10.about: Williams arrives at Duke as a polished scoring wing with impressive physical strength and offensive versatility. The 6'6" freshman excels at creating opportunities in the midrange, using his strong frame, advanced footwork and natural scoring instincts to establish himself as a potential lottery selection.
